description:
A powerful archiver that provides an ultrafast processing speed and convenient features.

Bandizip is a powerful archiver which provides an ultrafast processing speed and convenient features. Available free of charge, and its paid editions support a variety of advanced features.
- Supported OS: Windows 10/11 (x64/ARM64)
- All-inclusive compression/decompression/browsing/editing Archiver
- Extraction for 30+ formats, including RAR/RAR5/7Z/ZIP/ALZ/EGG
- Compressing an archive with password and multi-volume
- Fast compression with multi-core
- Windows 10/11 Context Menu support
- Fixed a vulnerability with some Compound files (KVE-2026-1904)
- Fixed a vulnerability with some NSIS files (KVE-2026-1628)
- Fixed a vulnerability with some ARC files (KVE-2026-1622)
- Fixed a vulnerability with some uncommon SFX archives (KVE-2026-1711)
- Fixed a vulnerability with some LZH and ARJ files (KVE-2026-1710)
- Fixed a vulnerability with some BOND files (KVE-2026-1709, KVE-2026-1712)
- Fixed a vulnerability that may occur when processing SPARSE data in some TAR files (KVE-2026-1759)
- Fixed a vulnerability that could occur during symbolic link processing (KVE-2026-1676)
- Other modifications
